Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH team,

Your detailed cost explanation, alongside the pricing controls discussed at our review, makes it sound like internal approval matters as much as the economics of this renewal. We want a durable agreement that supports sustainable business and planning certainty for both sides. How can we use contract duration and payment timing to reach an agreement within your approval authority?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,580 units per year for 24 months. Our demand forecast for Frequency converter 7.5 kW is up +10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 430.81 per unit, 90 days payment, 24 months, 4,580 units a year). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We welcome the proposed 24-month contract duration, which provides the planning certainty required to adjust our pricing to €432.94 per unit. However, we must maintain our standard 30-day payment terms, as extended payment periods fall outside our current approval parameters. 

Our current Angebot provides a price of €432.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. 

This offer reflects the maximum flexibility our pricing committee can authorize under the current cost structure. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. This proposal stays valid for 30 days.

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: a price of €430.01 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH team,

Your quotation includes extended payment, while your message and Credit Control insist on standard terms; it seems payment approval still needs internal alignment. We want a stable renewal that supports your planning certainty and reliable, on-time payment. How can the quoted payment basis be reconciled with your approval requirements?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,580 units per year for 24 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 431.54 per unit, 90 days payment, 24 months, 4,580 units a year). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Our current offer stands at a price of €432.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months.

To reconcile the payment basis with our approval requirements, we propose reverting to our standard 30-day payment terms. Extended payment terms of 90 days, as requested in your proposal, would not allow us to meet this price level. However, this adjustment to 30 days allows us to offer a price of €430.01 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months, providing you with a more favorable rate.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

Our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
